items.title: Footwork
items.name: Footwork
items.goal: Walk to the three rings, then circle the Kid while facing him.
items.intro: Stick moves you. Camera does the thinking. Walk to the rings. Then walk around the Kid without taking your eyes off him. He's harmless. Today.
items.success: Good. Feet first. Everything you'll ever do starts with where you're standing.
items.hint: You're facing him automatically. That's the lock-on. You just move ({move}); it does the looking.

items.title: Hands
items.name: Hands
items.goal: Land a full three-hit Light string: {l_names}.
items.intro: {light}. Three taps, three hits. {l_names} — or whatever your body calls them. Don't think. Tap.
items.success: That's a string. It'll work on a lot of people. Not on the good ones. We'll fix that.
items.hint: Tap {light}, let it land, tap again. Three times. Mash it and they trip over each other. The third hit's the one with the shove.
items.rush: Easy. One at a time: tap, let it land, tap again. Rush it and the next one cancels the last before it lands.

items.title: The big one
items.name: The big one
items.goal: Land a Heavy ({heavy_name}), then hold {heavy} to land a charged one.
items.intro: {heavy}. It's slower, it hurts more, and it shrugs off little hits while it's coming. Now hold it. Feel that? That's a charge. Let it go.
items.success: That's the one that ends arguments. It's also the one you'll miss most. Don't fall in love with it.
items.hint: Hold {heavy} until your fighter's whole body winds up. Then let go near him.

no_charge.intro: {heavy}. It's slower, it hurts more, and it shrugs off little hits while it's coming. Yours doesn't charge, so holding it buys you nothing. Land one clean.
no_charge.goal: Land a Heavy ({heavy_name}). Yours doesn't charge: one clean one does it.
no_charge.hint: Press {heavy} when he's in front of you. It's slow, so start it before you're on top of him.
no_charge.success: That's the one that ends arguments. Yours doesn't charge, so don't stand there holding it.

items.title: Hands up
items.name: Hands up
items.goal: Hold {guard} through the Kid's three-hit string (lose less than 10% health).
items.intro: Guard. Hold {guard}. He's gonna throw three. You'll take a little. You won't take a lot. That's the deal with guard — it costs stamina, so don't live there.
items.success: Hands up, chin down, everything else is details.
items.hint: Hold {guard} before his hands start moving and keep it held. Let go after the third.

items.title: Not there
items.name: Not there
items.goal: Dodge the Kid's Heavy without getting hit, then land a Dash Attack.
items.intro: {dodge} plus a direction. Short, quick, and for a split second nothing can touch you. Now — press {light} while you're dodging. That's a dash attack. It closes distance.
items.success: Nothing hits what isn't there. And when you come back, come back swinging.
items.hint: Wait for his big wind-up, then {dodge} sideways. For the dash attack, press {light} while you're still sliding.

no_dash.intro: {dodge} plus a direction. Short, quick, and for a split second nothing can touch you. Your fighter's got no dash attack, so the dodge is the whole lesson.
no_dash.goal: Dodge the Kid's Heavy without getting hit. (No dash attack in your kit.)
no_dash.hint: Wait for his big wind-up, then {dodge} sideways.
no_dash.success: Nothing hits what isn't there. No dash attack for you, so come back with your hands.

items.title: Your trick
items.name: Your trick
items.intro: {ability1}. That's yours. Every critter's got two tricks, and that's the first one — {ability1_name}. It's got a cooldown — see the ring? Use it, watch the ring, use it again.
items.success: That's what makes you you. Everything else, everyone's got.
items.hint: Press {ability1} when he's in front of you. Watch the little ring on the HUD — when it's full, it's ready.

skip.goal: Use your first ability ({ability1}). Your fighter hasn't got one.
skip.success: Your fighter has no trick in that slot. Nothing to practise. Moving on.

items.title: Hands on
items.name: Hands on
items.goal: Grab the Kid through his guard ({grab}) and throw him.
items.intro: He's guarding. Guard beats hands. Grab beats guard. {grab}, then push a direction to throw him. Toward the wall if you're feeling mean.
items.success: Strikes beat grabs. Grabs beat guard. Guard beats strikes. There's your triangle. Everything in this cage is three things.
items.hint: Walk right up to him while his guard's up, press {grab}, then push the stick toward the wall.

skip.goal: Grab the Kid through his guard ({grab}). Your fighter can't grab.
skip.success: No grab in your kit. Guard beats hands, and you've got nothing that beats guard. Work around him. Moving on.

items.title: The read
items.name: The read
items.goal: Parry two attacks: tap {guard} right as they land.
items.intro: Here's the next layer. Guard, but late — right as it lands. That's a parry. He stumbles, you're free. Watch his shoulder. The shoulder never lies.
items.success: That's a read. Do that to the Commissioner and I'll put your picture up myself.
items.hint: Don't hold {guard}. Tap it the instant his hand reaches you. Early is a block. Late is a bruise. The window's small — it's supposed to be.

items.title: Close it
items.name: Close it
items.goal: Land a Finisher ({light} {light} then {heavy}), then fill Hype and pop {juice_name} ({juice}).
items.intro: Two lights, then {heavy} in the middle of the string. That's your finisher. Now the fun part: see the meter? That's Hype. Hits fill it. Getting hit fills it. Taunting fills it — {taunt} — if you've got the nerve. Full meter, {juice}. That's the JUICE. Yours is called {juice_name}. Don't ask what's in it.
items.success: That's the whole kit. Hands, heavy, guard, dodge, grab, two tricks, and the JUICE. Everything after this is timing.
items.hint: {light}, {light}, then {heavy} quickly. For the JUICE: fill the meter — taunt with {taunt} when he's far away — then press {juice}.

no_finisher.intro: No finisher in your kit: two lights and {heavy} just gets you a Heavy. So, the fun part: see the meter? That's Hype. Hits fill it. Getting hit fills it. Taunting fills it — {taunt} — if you've got the nerve. Full meter, {juice}. That's the JUICE. Yours is called {juice_name}. Don't ask what's in it.
no_finisher.goal: Fill Hype and pop {juice_name} ({juice}). (No finisher in your kit.)
no_finisher.hint: Fill the meter: hit him, or taunt with {taunt} when he's far away. Then press {juice}.

no_juice.intro: Two lights, then {heavy} in the middle of the string. That's your finisher. Your kit's got no JUICE, so that's the whole lesson.
no_juice.goal: Land a Finisher ({light} {light} then {heavy}). (No JUICE in your kit.)
no_juice.success: That's the whole kit. Hands, heavy, guard, dodge, grab, your tricks. No JUICE for you. Everything after this is timing.

skip.goal: Land a Finisher, then pop the JUICE. Your fighter has neither.
skip.success: No finisher and no JUICE in your kit. Nothing to close with but your hands. Moving on.

items.title: Freestyle
items.name: Freestyle
items.goal: Beat the Kid in a 60-second round: KO him, or have more health left at the bell.
items.intro: Alright. He's gonna fight back now. Sixty seconds. Use whatever you learned. Use whatever you didn't. Go.
items.success: Hm. Fine. Granny's corner is always open. Go lose to someone better and come tell me about it.
items.hint: Guard when he winds up. Hit him when he's done. Three things, kid.
